mentions.name: Niblet – Weaning Diary
mentions.description: This app helps parents during baby weaning to log the foods their baby eats and add any reactions (such as rashes), so patterns can be spotted when discussing with their GP. It also provides weaning advice on nutrients, food variety, and how to serve food, sourced from the NHS and FSA.
mentions.problem: Parents weaning their baby struggle to work out what food pattern is causing reactions like rashes, and need a record to show their GP.
mentions.audience: Parents who are weaning their babies.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I created an app for weaning parents to log the food, add any reactions so when talking to their GP they can start to see a pattern and all advice, like nutrients, food variety, how to serve food all coming from the NHS and FSA.

evidence.value: So I created an app for weaning parents to log the food, add any reactions so when talking to their GP they can start to see a pattern and all advice, like nutrients, food variety, how to serve food all coming from the NHS and FSA.
